description: This file configures testing environment for extension voice call features using Vitest. It imports configuration utilities and defines functions to load include patterns from environment variables and to create a scoped Vitest configuration specific to the extension voice call tests.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include file patterns from environment variables or defaults to null.

methods.name: export function createExtensionVoiceCallVitestConfig( createExtensionVoiceCallVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for extension voice call tests, merging include patterns from environment or default roots with specific test setup options.
